name: crud-create
description: Apple Calendar client creates a timed event via conditional PUT

steps.note: Conditional PUT with If-None-Match: * creates a new event resource

request.body:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:create-0001@example.test
DTSTAMP:20260115T000000Z
DTSTART:20260115T090000Z
DTEND:20260115T100000Z
SUMMARY:New event
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
